hero.title: We create unique events that get people laughing, participating, and connecting.
hero.sub: From company parties that break the usual mold to nonprofit fundraisers people actually remember, we make gatherings worth showing up for.
hero.imageAlt: Audience members cheering, laughing, and filming the stage at Why'd They Do That?!

cards.title: Interactive Events & Game Shows
cards.body: Hosted game shows and original activities that get the room involved, not just watching.
cards.imageAlt: Audience members laughing during a live show

cards.title: Emcee & Event Hosting
cards.for: For events that already have a plan.
cards.body: Professional hosting from Max, with wit, warmth, and the experience to keep the program moving.
cards.imageAlt: Max on stage with a microphone, arm outstretched toward the audience

cards.title: Creative Campaigns
cards.for: Especially for nonprofits and community causes.
cards.body: Unexpected campaign ideas that help a cause stand out and invite people to take part.
cards.imageAlt: Kids shrieking with excitement around a giant gong

problem.title: Another dinner and a few speeches?
problem.body: There's nothing wrong with a traditional event. But if you want people to participate, connect, and remember the experience, there are more interesting ways to do it.
problem.imageAlt: Max with a microphone fires up a cheering crowd packed onto hay bales at a nighttime outdoor event

steps.title: Tell us what you're planning.
steps.body: Share the occasion, audience, goals, date, and budget if known.

steps.title: Shape the right idea.
steps.body: We recommend an existing format or develop a custom approach.

steps.title: Make it happen.
steps.body: Max leads and brings in collaborators when the project needs them.

closing.title: Your event can be the one people talk about afterward.
closing.body: Tell us what you're planning. We'll figure out the most interesting way to bring it to life.
